rubric.why: Identifies ciphertext as the encrypted form of the original message.
rubric.description: Defines ciphertext as an encrypted message or plaintext.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that ciphertext is the encrypted form of a message.

rubric.why: Explains that ciphertext needs to be decoded or decrypted to be understood.
rubric.description: States that ciphertext is coded or not normally understandable until decrypted.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that decryption is needed to understand the message.

modelAnswer: Ciphertext is the encrypted form of a message (plaintext).
It is coded and cannot normally be understood until it is decrypted.

items.followUp: State two ways to protect data from unauthorized access.

rubric.why: States the main purpose of data security.
rubric.description: Data security protects data from access by unauthorized people.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that security protects data from unauthorized access.

rubric.why: Identifies an additional threat to data that security helps prevent.
rubric.description: Security also helps prevent misuse, alteration, damage, loss or theft of data.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning at least one additional threat to data.

modelAnswer: Data security is necessary to protect data from access by unauthorized people.
It also helps prevent data from being misused, altered, damaged or lost.

items.followUp: What is one advantage of sharing files over a network?

rubric.why: Captures the basic meaning of file sharing.
rubric.description: File sharing makes files available to others.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that files are shared or made available to others.

rubric.why: Identifies the users or computers involved, or the network used to exchange files.
rubric.description: File sharing lets users or computers exchange files, commonly over a network.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning other users/computers or exchange over a network.

modelAnswer: File sharing is the process of making files available to other users or computers.
It commonly allows users to exchange files over a network.
